```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(arrow)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(survival)
```


```{r}
df_large <- read_parquet(
"C:\\Users\\CICP\\Desktop\\My_Computer\\Professional\\Github\\new_dataset\\simulation_complete\\df_large_sim.parquet"
)
```

**Conversion from hospitalization level to patient level**

```{r}
# Convert the dataset from the hospitalization level to the patient level:
# keep only inclusion stays, then retain the earliest inclusion stay
# for each patient according to inclusion_start.
# If several stays have the same earliest date, keep only one of them.
df_patient <- df_large |>
  filter(inclusion_flag == TRUE) |>
  group_by(patient_id) |>
  slice_min(
    order_by = inclusion_start,
    n = 1,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) |>
  ungroup()
```

**Cardiovascular history variables**

```{r}
# Create patient-level cardiovascular disease indicators from CIM-10 variables,
# then combine them into a composite cardiovascular history variable.
#
# For each disease indicator:
#   1 = the corresponding cardiovascular disease is present,
#   0 = the corresponding cardiovascular disease is absent,
#   NA = the disease status cannot be determined from the available data.
#
# The composite cv_history variable is coded as:
#   1 if at least one cardiovascular condition is present,
#   0 if all cardiovascular conditions are absent,
#   NA if no condition is present but at least one component is missing.

df_patient <- df_patient |>
  mutate(
    ischemic_heart_disease = case_when(
        CIM_10_I20 == 1 |
        CIM_10_I21 == 1 |
        CIM_10_I22 == 1 |
        CIM_10_I25 == 1 ~ 1,
        TRUE ~ 0,
    )
  )


df_patient <- df_patient |>
  mutate(
    atrial_fibrillation = case_when(
        CIM_10_I48 == 1 ~ 1,
        TRUE ~ 0,
    )
  )



df_patient <- df_patient |>
  mutate(
    chronic_heart_failure = case_when(
        CIM_10_I50 == 1 ~ 1,
        TRUE ~ 0,
    )
  )


df_patient <- df_patient |>
  mutate(
    cv_history = case_when(
      ischemic_heart_disease == 1 |
      atrial_fibrillation == 1 |
      chronic_heart_failure == 1 |
      cerebral_vascular_accident_cum == 1 ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
      
    )
  )
```

**Composite severity indicator** 

```{r}
# Create a composite severity indicator based on acute respiratory failure
# and the minimum recorded pH value:
#   1 = acute respiratory failure is present or pH is below 7.38,
#   0 = acute respiratory failure is absent or pH is at least 7.38,
#   NA = severity cannot be determined from the available data.

df_patient <- df_patient |>
  mutate(severity = case_when(
    Ins_Resp_Aigue_J96 == 1 | ph_min < 7.38 ~ 1,
    Ins_Resp_Aigue_J96 == 0 | ph_min >= 7.38 ~ 0,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )
)
```


**Patient-level medication indicators**

```{r}
# Create patient-level medication indicators from the corresponding ATC groups
# for beta-blockers, ACE inhibitors, ARBs,
# and aldosterone antagonists/potassium-sparing agents.
#
# For each medication class:
#   1 = at least one related ATC group is present,
#   0 = all related ATC groups are absent,
#   NA = medication use cannot be determined from the available data.

# C07A BETA BLOCKING AGENTS
# C07B BETA BLOCKING AGENTS AND THIAZIDES
# C07C BETA BLOCKING AGENTS AND OTHER DIURETICS
# C07D BETA BLOCKING AGENTS, THIAZIDES AND OTHER DIURETICS
# C07E BETA BLOCKING AGENTS AND VASODILATORS
# C07F BETA BLOCKING AGENTS, OTHER COMBINATIONS

df_patient <- df_patient |>
  mutate(
    beta_blocker = case_when(
        cum_cor_ATC_C07A == 1 |
        cum_cor_ATC_C07B == 1 |
        cum_cor_ATC_C07D == 1 |
        cum_cor_ATC_C07F == 1 ~ 1,
        
        TRUE ~ 0
    )
  )

# C09A ACE INHIBITORS, PLAIN
# C09B ACE INHIBITORS, COMBINATIONS

df_patient <- df_patient |>
  mutate( ACE = 
    case_when(
      cum_cor_ATC_C09A == 1 |
      cum_cor_ATC_C09B == 1 ~ 1,
      
      TRUE ~ 0
    )
  )

# C09C ANGIOTENSIN II RECEPTOR BLOCKERS (ARBs), PLAIN
# C09D ANGIOTENSIN II RECEPTOR BLOCKERS (ARBs), COMBINATIONS

df_patient <- df_patient |>
  mutate( ARB = 
            case_when(
              cum_cor_ATC_C09C == 1 |
              cum_cor_ATC_C09D == 1 ~ 1,
              
              TRUE ~ 0
        )
  )


# C03D ALDOSTERONE ANTAGONISTS AND OTHER POTASSIUM-SPARING AGENTS
df_patient <- df_patient |>
  mutate( Aldosterone = 
            case_when(
                cum_cor_ATC_C03D == 1 ~ 1,
              TRUE ~ 0
            )
  )
```

**Optimal Medical Therapy score**

```{r}
# Create the Optimal Medical Therapy (OMT) score by summing:
#   1 point for beta-blocker use,
#   1 point for either ACE inhibitor or ARB use,
#   1 point for aldosterone antagonist use.
#
# ACE inhibitors and ARBs are treated as one therapeutic component,
# so using both does not add more than one point.
# The resulting OMT score ranges from 0 to 3.
df_patient <- df_patient |>
  mutate(OMT = beta_blocker + pmax(ACE, ARB) + Aldosterone,
         OMT = factor(OMT))
```

**Create diabetes variable**

```{r}
df_patient <- df_patient |>
  mutate(diabetes = 
           case_when(
             diabetes_uncomp_cum == 1 |
             diabetes_comp_cum == 1 ~ 1,
             TRUE ~ 0
           )
         )
```


```{r}
vars_cc <- c(
  "duree_CJP_1an",
  "CJP_1an",
  "cv_history",
  "AGE",
  "gender",
  "OMT",
  "CCI_score",
  "severity",
  "oxygene_first",
  "diabetes",
  "kidney_disease_cum",
  "liver_cum",
  "metastatic_cancer_cum",
  "ATCD_pulm_chronique",
  "dementia_cum",
  "Neurologic_disease_cum"
)

df_cc <- df_patient |>
  filter(if_all(all_of(vars_cc), ~ !is.na(.)))
```

**Unadjusted Cox Model**

```{r}
cox_unadjusted <- coxph(
  Surv(time = duree_CJP_1an, event = CJP_1an) ~ cv_history,
  data = df_cc,
)
summary(cox_unadjusted)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
# Extract HR and 95% CI
cox_sum <- summary(cox_unadjusted)

forest_data <- data.frame(
  Variable = "Cardiovascular history",
  HR = cox_sum$conf.int[, "exp(coef)"],
  lower_CI = cox_sum$conf.int[, "lower .95"],
  upper_CI = cox_sum$conf.int[, "upper .95"],
  p_value = cox_sum$coefficients[, "Pr(>|z|)"]
)


# Forest plot
ggplot(
  forest_data,
  aes(x = HR, y = Variable)
) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(xmin = lower_CI, xmax = upper_CI),
    height = 0.15
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 1,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(
    x = "Hazard Ratio (95% CI)",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Unadjusted Cox proportional hazards model"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

```{r}
cox_adjusted <- coxph(
  Surv(time = duree_CJP_1an, event = CJP_1an) ~ cv_history +
  AGE +
  gender +
  OMT +
  oxygene_first +
  CCI_score +
  severity +
  diabetes +
  kidney_disease_cum +
  liver_cum +
  metastatic_cancer_cum +
  ATCD_pulm_chronique +
  dementia_cum +
  Neurologic_disease_cum,
  data = df_cc
)
summary(cox_adjusted)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
# Extract results from the adjusted Cox model
cox_summary <- summary(cox_adjusted)

forest_data <- data.frame(
  variable = rownames(cox_summary$conf.int),
  HR = cox_summary$conf.int[, "exp(coef)"],
  lower = cox_summary$conf.int[, "lower .95"],
  upper = cox_summary$conf.int[, "upper .95"],
  p_value = cox_summary$coefficients[, "Pr(>|z|)"]
)

# Create formatted labels
forest_data$HR_CI <- sprintf(
  "%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)",
  forest_data$HR,
  forest_data$lower,
  forest_data$upper
)

forest_data$p_label <- ifelse(
  forest_data$p_value < 0.001,
  "<0.001",
  sprintf("%.3f", forest_data$p_value)
)

# Sort from largest HR to smallest HR
forest_data <- forest_data[
  order(forest_data$HR, decreasing = TRUE),
]

# Preserve this order in the plot
forest_data$variable <- factor(
  forest_data$variable,
  levels = rev(forest_data$variable)
)

# Position of the text column
text_position <- max(forest_data$upper, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.5

# Forest plot
ggplot(forest_data, aes(x = HR, y = variable)) +

  # Reference line: HR = 1
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 1,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +

  # 95% confidence intervals
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper),
    height = 0.15,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +

  # Hazard ratios
  geom_point(
    size = 3
  ) +

  # HR, 95% CI and p-value
  geom_text(
    aes(
      x = text_position,
      label = paste0(
        HR_CI,
        "   p = ",
        p_label
      )
    ),
    hjust = 0,
    size = 3.5
  ) +

  # Logarithmic HR scale
  scale_x_log10() +

  labs(
    title = "Adjusted Cox proportional hazards model",
    x = "Hazard Ratio (95% CI)",
    y = NULL
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +

  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.margin = margin(
      t = 10,
      r = 180,
      b = 10,
      l = 10
    )
  )
```
